title: RealFish
description: added a more realistic fishing process to the game, with upgraded fishing gears and more catchable fish, or even add fish entities from other mod on your rod
body:
added 4 reel items and 4 rods to the game, iron rod take more durability damage from saltwater, gold rod do less damage to big fishs but way better to the small ones, diamond is stronger but reel slower, the netherite is just unbreakable.
added 8 fishes to the game.they can not be spawned natrally.
able to add any other entities as fish, just build it in the config file.
